notes.title: Strawb 2.1.0 - Now available in French
notes.content:
Ahoi,
The puzzle game Strawb is updated to 2.1.0

Changes:
- Added French language.
- Reworked controls input screen to better work with localization.

Enjoy ;)
Noxlor

notes.title: Strawb updated to 2.0.6
notes.content:
Ahoi,
Strawb is updated to 2.0.6

Changes:

Enjoy ;)

notes.title: Strawb updated to 2.0.5
notes.content:
Ahoi,
Strawb is updated to 2.0.5

Changes:
- Added a hint to level 29. Several players had struggles to proceed. This should be better now.
- Added a custom mouse cursor to the game.
- Improved dead zones when the game is played with a controller.
